# The Muse

> > The Muse is a career platform providing comprehensive salary data, job listings, and career advice across tech and professional roles at companies like Apple, Coinbase, Deloitte, and PwC.

The Muse offers detailed salary information for technology and professional positions across major U.S. cities and remote roles, helping job seekers understand compensation ranges at top employers. The platform specializes in tech careers including software engineering, quality assurance, data science, and UX/UI design roles.

## Key Topics

- Salary Information
- Tech Jobs & Careers
- Quality Assurance Roles
- Software Engineering
- UX/UI Design
- Data Science & Machine Learning
- Remote Work Opportunities
- Apple
- Coinbase
- Deloitte
- PwC
- Major Tech Hubs (Pittsburgh, Austin, Seattle, Boston, San Diego)
- Job Listings
- Career Development

## Quality Assurance & Testing Salaries

- [Quality Assurance Specialist in Seattle, WA Salary](https://www.themuse.com/salaries/seattle/quality-assurance-specialist): Seattle QA Specialist salary: $46K-$161K avg $97K at GoodRx, Providence
- [Software Quality Assurance Analyst in Denver, CO Salary](https://www.themuse.com/salaries/denver/software-quality-assurance-analyst): Denver QA Analyst salary data: $55K-$157K avg $105K at Visa, Esri
- [Test Engineer in Pittsburgh, PA Salary](https://www.themuse.com/salaries/pittsburgh/test-engineer): Pittsburgh Test Engineer salary: $52K-$129K avg $90K at GE Aerospace, Eaton
- [Test Engineer in Boston, MA Salary](https://www.themuse.com/salaries/boston/test-engineer): Boston Test Engineer salary: $73K-$160K avg $116K at Schneider Electric, RTX
